author: Bellular News
description:
Riot are ending active development on 2XKO after a decade of work. Cutting half the team just a month and a half after launch helped destroy player confidence, and now they need those players to trust them with an MMO. The game will remain playable.

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!

00:00 Can Players Still Trust Riot?
00:45 Ten Years, Then Layoffs
01:46 What Happens to 2XKO Now?
03:47 Why 2XKO Failed
08:20 What This Means for Riot’s MMO
10:02 Why Give Riot Years of Your Time?
